question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become supported public Plugin SDK exports, or should the progress discriminator remain an internal reply-delivery contract?
rationale: The PR intentionally expands a shipped Plugin SDK subpath, creating a permanent compatibility surface; code inspection can assess correctness but cannot establish maintainer intent for that public API boundary.

options.title: Approve and document the public contract
options.body: Keep the generic exports, document their intended plugin use and stability, then fix native-block propagation and add compatibility-focused coverage.

options.title: Keep the discriminator internal
options.body: Move the constant and predicate behind an internal reply-runtime seam while preserving the same Codex-to-Slack behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve and document the public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the generic exports, document their intended plugin use and stability, then fix native-block propagation and add compatibility-focused coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The history shows broad ownership across Slack delivery and Plugin SDK reply surfaces, making this the strongest available routing candidate for the API-boundary choice.
